# Crayon Roofing & Structures — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary

This batch of audio transcripts is overwhelmingly **internal operations chatter** — loading/unloading coordination, driver directions, GPS/location calls, "vandi anuப்பு" (send the vehicle) calls, e-way bill/government shutdown worries, bank payment follow-ups, staff attendance, gift-distribution logistics for Diwali, and Google-expo/cold-call spam. Only a modest subset are genuine **sales conversations** — customer enquiries about roofing sheet rate, thickness/GSM, color availability, screws, welding rods, decking sheets, PUF panels, and dealer/cash-and-carry pricing negotiations. This note is built strictly from those genuine sales exchanges; it is **not a large or diverse sample**, so treat the patterns below as directional, not exhaustive. Several calls repeat the same scripted rate lines almost verbatim (e.g., JSW Color On Plus 0.47mm rate), suggesting the sales team works off a fixed price sheet that varies slightly call to call (₹430–465+GST), which itself is a coaching flag (see below).

## Products & brand ladder

Crayon Roofing & Structures is a **supply-only distributor** (confirmed explicitly: *"Fixing எதுவும் பண்றது கிடையாது. Supply மட்டும் பண்ணிட்டு இருக்கோம்."* [We don't do fixing/installation, only supply]). Core product lines mentioned in real sales calls:

- **JSW Color On Plus** — flagship metal roofing sheet brand. Available in multiple thicknesses: 0.47mm, 0.50mm, 0.60mm. AZ coating grades: AZ70 and AZ150 ("level coating," not a literal thickness — *"thickness-ன்ற மாதிரி வராது சார், level coated"*). Colors: sky blue, off white, grey, blue, red, brick red ("color on plus-னா நம்ம எல்லா color-உம் இருக்கும்").
- **Pragathi / Pragathi Plus** — a JSW-family budget/economy line. Limited stock colors only: **sky blue and off white** ("Pragathi-ல sky blue off white மட்டும் தான் இருக்கும்"). No grey or brick red kept in regular stock; grey only sourced externally for large (10-ton) orders.
- **Indradhanush** (JSW) — another economy variant, cheaper than Color On Plus, AZ70, thickness around 0.40–0.45mm, also limited to sky blue/half white.
- **PUF (Puff) roof panels** — 50mm thick insulated panels, sold per square meter, with top/bottom thickness specified.
- **Polycarbonate sheets** — sold by thickness (2mm mentioned), used for skylights/translucent roofing.
- **Decking sheets** — 0.8mm, 1mm, 1.2mm variants; used for structural flooring (e.g., transformer platforms).
- **Barricade/metal roofing sheet** for commercial site hoarding (off-white, 15 feet, profiling queried).
- **Flashing accessories** — L-flashing, ridge/crimp flashing sold in standard 2.5-meter lengths, billed as "numbers" not loose meters.
- **Screws** — Tata brand self-tapping screws, multiple sizes (1 inch, 1.5", 2", 2.5", 3", up to 130mm), Double Thread (DT) vs Full Thread (FT) variants, stitch screws.
- **Welding rods/electrodes** — Tata brand, sold by size (2.5mm common) and packed in boxes/cartons.
- **Cutting/grinding wheels** — 4-inch cutting wheel mentioned.

| JSW Color On Plus | 0.47mm, AZ150 | ₹430 / 435 / 445 / 455 / 465 + GST per sq.m (varies call to call) |
| JSW Color On Plus | 0.50mm, AZ150, "15 years warranty" | ₹475 + GST per sq.m |
| JSW Color On Plus | 0.60mm, AZ150 | ₹560 + GST per sq.m |

| Pragathi | 150 GSM (aluminum coating level) | ₹435 + tax |
| Pragathi Plus | 0.40mm | ₹105 + GST |
| Indradhanush (JSW) | 0.45mm, AZ70 | ₹375 + tax |
| Indradhanush | 0.40mm | ₹335 + tax |
| Plain/Silver On Plus sheet | AZ150, 0.47mm, kg basis | ₹101 + GST per kg |
| General JSW sheet | kg basis | ₹107 + GST per kg |
| Cash & Carry price (steel coil, generic) | — | ₹100 + tax for direct ask; ₹98–98.50 "rotation"/bulk price quoted by rivals, debated internally |
| Credit price vs Cash & Carry | — | "Cash and Carry-க்கு ₹100-ன்னா credit-க்கு ₹1 extra" [credit adds ₹1 over cash price] |
| Self-tapping screw | 130mm | ₹14 + GST per screw |
| Welding rod (offer) | 2.5mm | ₹270–336 incl./+GST (varies) |
| Price hike flagged repeatedly | Tata welding rod/screw/cutting wheel | **"1st தேதி-ல இருந்து 10% rate ஏறுது"** [from the 1st, rate increases 10%] — used to create urgency |

**Terms observed:** GST is always added separately and explicitly stated; rate basis (square meter vs kg vs per-sheet/number) is a constant point of confusion and must be clarified every call; loading/transport is extra and not included in sheet rate; bulk orders (5+ ton) can get out-of-stock colors (e.g., grey) sourced specially; advance payment (seen: 50% advance, ₹4,00,000 advance on a large order) is required before production/dispatch on manufactured (non-stock) items; standard delivery promise is "Monday/Tuesday" or "evening" for ready stock, 1 day minimum for coil-run (manufactured) items.

## Objection Playbook

**"Your rate is higher than what a competitor/your own staff quoted"**
> *"இது dealer-க்கு என்ன price கொடுப்போமோ கடைக்கு என்ன price கொடுப்போமோ அதுதான் கொடுத்துருக்கோம்... நீங்க கடைக்காரங்களுக்கு இந்த rate தான் கொடுக்குறீங்கன்னு நான் எப்படி நம்புறது?"* [We've given you the same price we give dealers/shops... how can I trust that's really the rate you give shopkeepers?]
Response pattern used: insist "MD/Sir approved this specific price for you," refuse further discount, but occasionally yield a token ₹5/sq.m reduction ("150-ல மட்டும் ஒரு ₹5 வேணும்னா கம்மி பண்ணி வாங்கி கொடுக்கலாம்").
